name: @repo/css-modules-kit
description: CSS modules tooling for the monorepo packages: the Lightning CSS scoping their builds share, and css-modules-kit's codegen (`cmk`) for their typings, plus the typings of the plain stylesheets they import for side effects. Its own package because cmk needs the TypeScript 6 compiler API (`@typescript/typescript6`, aliased as `typescript` here), which the TypeScript 7 the rest of the repo runs on does not ship.

scripts.generate: pnpm run generate:vision && pnpm run generate:test-studio && pnpm run generate:pandacss
